newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 10 on form Panamax grain fixing.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 10 on form Panamax grain fixing.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was up 10 at 1,503 points on Thursday.

Brokers reported firm Panamax grain fixtures in the Atlantic with Safmarine booking Oceanic Explorer 68,849 dwt delivery Passero prompt for trip via Plate to Japan at $15,800 daily and Cargill the 1978-built Minerva 61,800 dwt delivery Holland early April for two laden legs via East Coast South America to the Continent at $10,500 daily.
The Baltic Handy Index was up one to 1,104 points in quiet trading.
AT 1300 gmt BIFFEX was between 27 and five points higher and turnover totalled 96 lots.
